description: This file defines filesystem-related functions, classes, and exceptions for the Battle for Wesnoth project, including file operations, directory management, checksum calculations, and path handling.

classes.name: io_exception
classes.description: Exception class for IO errors, derived from std::exception, with custom message handling.

classes.name: file_tree_checksum
classes.description: Structure representing checksum information of a file or directory tree, including number of files, total size, and last modified time.

classes.name: binary_paths_manager
classes.description: Class managing binary file paths, initialized from configuration, responsible for path storage and cleanup.

classes.name: scoped_istream
classes.description: RAII wrapper for std::istream pointers, ensuring proper resource management.

classes.name: scoped_ostream
classes.description: RAII wrapper for std::ostream pointers, ensuring proper resource management.

methods.name: get_files_in_dir
methods.description: Populates vectors with files and directories within a specified directory, based on mode.

methods.name: get_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory part of a given path.

methods.name: get_prefs_file
methods.description: Returns the path to the preferences file.

methods.name: get_save_index_file
methods.description: Returns the path to the save index file.

methods.name: get_saves_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory for save files.

methods.name: get_cache_dir
methods.description: Returns the cache directory path.

methods.name: get_intl_dir
methods.description: Returns the internationalization directory.

methods.name: get_screenshot_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory for screenshots.

methods.name: get_user_data_dir
methods.description: Returns the user data directory.

methods.name: get_cwd
methods.description: Returns the current working directory.

methods.name: make_directory
methods.description: Creates a new directory.

methods.name: delete_directory
methods.description: Deletes a specified directory.

methods.name: filesystem_init
methods.description: Initializes the filesystem, returns success status.

methods.name: read_file
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a string.

methods.name: istream_file
methods.description: Returns an input stream for a file.

methods.name: ostream_file
methods.description: Returns an output stream for a file.

methods.name: write_file
methods.description: Writes data to a specified file, throws io_exception on error.

methods.name: read_stdin
methods.description: Reads input from standard input.

methods.name: read_map
methods.description: Reads map data from a file.

methods.name: is_directory
methods.description: Checks if a path is a directory.

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists.

methods.name: file_create_time
methods.description: Returns the creation time of a file.

methods.name: get_file_tree_checksum
methods.description: Returns checksum info for a directory tree.

methods.name: data_tree_checksum
methods.description: Returns checksum info for the data directory.

methods.name: file_size
methods.description: Returns size of a file or -1 if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: file_name
methods.description: Returns the base filename, stripping directory path.

methods.name: directory_name
methods.description: Returns the directory part of a file path.

methods.name: clear_binary_paths_cache
methods.description: Clears cached binary paths.

methods.name: get_binary_paths
methods.description: Returns all possible paths for a given binary type.

methods.name: get_binary_file_location
methods.description: Returns the full path to a binary file if present.

methods.name: scoped_istream
methods.description: Constructor and destructor manage stream resource.

methods.name: scoped_ostream
methods.description: Constructor and destructor manage stream resource.
